ns2:course.label: Yoga Teacher Training
ns2:course.description: This course introduces basic yoga philosophy. Course content also includes discussion of the ethics involved in teaching yoga as well as applying prior experience with teaching and anatomy to teaching yoga asana. Prerequisite: DANC 301 and DANC 302. For dance majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: DANC 301 and DANC 302. For dance majors only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
